input.quote: 10.3 Assignment. This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 is a bare successors-and-assigns clause: it neither confirms our right to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, nor restricts HDI from assigning the Agreement (including to a Deerskin competitor). The Agreement contains no change-of-control provision, so HDI has no termination or re-pricing trigger today, but the silence leaves the point open. The playbook preferred position requires the express customer carve-out, a consent standard on the Vendor side (not unreasonably withheld, never to a competitor), and confirmation that our change of control is not an assignment and gives HDI no exit. We propose a single sentence added to § 10.3; fallback is mutual successor assignment on written notice with consent not unreasonably withheld for other assignments.

proposal.summary: Add customer affiliate/successor assignment carve-out, HDI consent restriction, and no change-of-control right for HDI in § 10.3
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added our customary assignment terms: we may assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, HDI may assign only with our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and never to our competitor, and our change of control gives HDI no termination or re-pricing right. As a fallback we can accept mutual successor assignment on written notice with consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld.

ops.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Company may assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without HDI's consent, to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets. HDI may not assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the Company's prior written consent (which shall not be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of the Company. No change of control of the Company shall constitute an assignment or give HDI any right to terminate, suspend, re-price or otherwise modify this Agreement.
